metadata.name: magiclob
metadata.description: MagiCLOB - a price-time priority CLOB engine on Magicblock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: borrow_flashloan_base
docs: Borrow base tokens from the vault via flash loan.

instructions.name: borrow_flashloan_quote
docs: Borrow quote tokens from the vault via flash loan.

instructions.name: bulk_batch_orders
docs: Atomic batch of limit/market orders.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Signer authorizing use of the trader; also the default integrator.

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Remove a resting order by owner + client order id.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Signer authorizing use of the trader; also the default integrator.

instructions.name: claim_rebates
docs: Claim maker rebates for providing liquidity during low-fee epochs.

instructions.name: delegate_trader_session
docs: ER: delegate the trader + order book to an Ephemeral Rollup session.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Fee payer of the session (signs the delegation).

accounts.name: owner
docs: Wallet that owns and authorizes the trader session.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit SPL tokens into the pool vault.

instructions.name: execute_proposal
docs: Execute a passed proposal to apply fee changes.

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Create `MarketState` + `OrderBookState` + `VaultState` PDAs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Admin; becomes `MarketState.authority`.

instructions.name: initialize_vault_accounts
docs: Lazily create the vault's SPL base/quote token accounts (idempotent).

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Pays the rent-exempt lamports for the two vault token accounts.

accounts.name: base_vault_account
docs: as an `UncheckedAccount` because it may not exist yet (idempotent no-op
once created). Ownership/state are validated inside the handler before
any mutation.

instructions.name: modify_order
docs: Modify a resting order's quantity/price.

accounts.name: market
docs: to keep the SBPF stack frame under the 4096-byte limit. `owner = crate::ID`
constrains it to a program-owned data account at handoff, and `handle`
re-deserializes and validates `MarketState` (ensure_active) before any
mutation, so no unchecked access occurs.

instructions.name: place_limit_order
docs: Place a limit order with time-in-force and self-trade prevention.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Signer authorizing use of the trader; also the default integrator.

instructions.name: place_market_order
docs: Sweep the opposite side until filled or the book is exhausted.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Signer authorizing use of the trader; also the default integrator.

instructions.name: register_trader
docs: Create a `TraderState` for `(market, owner)`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Rent payer. May differ from `owner`.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Wallet that owns the internal balance ledger.

instructions.name: return_flashloan_base
docs: Repay a base flash loan (principal + fee).

instructions.name: return_flashloan_quote
docs: Repay a quote flash loan (principal + fee).

instructions.name: settle_and_undelegate
docs: ER: commit the session state and undelegate (release the Delegation lock).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Session fee payer.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Wallet that owns and authorizes settlement and undelegation.

instructions.name: stake
docs: Lock quote tokens into a StakeInfo PDA for fee discounts and governance.

instructions.name: submit_proposal
docs: Submit a governance proposal to change market fees.

instructions.name: unstake
docs: Release staked tokens after the epoch lockup period.

instructions.name: vote
docs: Vote for or against an active proposal.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Withdraw SPL tokens from the pool vault.

types.name: DepositEvent
docs: Emitted on deposit into the pool vault.

types.name: Fill
docs: One executed fill report.

fields.name: price
docs: Execution price of this fill.

fields.name: qty
docs: Filled base quantity.

fields.name: maker_order_id
docs: Sequence id of the resting (maker) order.

fields.name: maker
docs: Owner of the resting (maker) order.

fields.name: maker_fee
docs: Maker fee charged on this fill.

fields.name: market
docs: Market this flash loan belongs to.

fields.name: borrower
docs: Borrower of the flash loan.

fields.name: asset
docs: Asset type: 0 = base, 1 = quote.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount borrowed.

fields.name: fee
docs: Fee charged for the flash loan.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: FlashLoanEvent
docs: Emitted on flash loan borrow.

fields.name: authority
docs: Admin that can pause/delist the market. Set at init to the initializer.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: Base asset mint.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Quote asset mint.

fields.name: taker_fee_bps
docs: Taker fee rate in bps, charged on the executed notional.

fields.name: maker_fee_bps
docs: Maker fee rate in bps, charged on the executed notional.

fields.name: integrator_fee_bps_cap
docs: Upper bound for the integrator fee rate of any resting order.

fields.name: status
docs: Current market status.

fields.name: accumulated_fees
docs: Running counter of protocol fees collected (taker + maker).

fields.name: accumulated_integrator_fees
docs: Running counter of integrator fees collected.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `[b"market", base_mint, quote_mint]`.

fields.name: tick_size
docs: Minimum price increment (quote units per base unit).

fields.name: lot_size
docs: Minimum quantity increment (base units).

fields.name: min_size
docs: Minimum order quantity (base units).

fields.name: epoch
docs: Current epoch number.

fields.name: epoch_start_timestamp
docs: Epoch start timestamp (unix millis).

fields.name: epoch_duration
docs: Epoch duration in milliseconds.

fields.name: current_taker_fee_bps
docs: Current epoch taker fee (bps).

fields.name: current_maker_fee_bps
docs: Current epoch maker fee (bps).

fields.name: next_taker_fee_bps
docs: Next epoch taker fee (bps), applied at epoch transition.

fields.name: next_maker_fee_bps
docs: Next epoch maker fee (bps), applied at epoch transition.

fields.name: stake_required
docs: Minimum quote stake required for fee discounts / governance.

fields.name: min_order_size
docs: Minimum order quantity allowed in this market.

fields.name: maker_rebate_bps
docs: Maker rebate basis points for staked traders (subtracted from maker fee).

fields.name: base_decimals
docs: Base token decimals (SCPB/SFT order sizes are in base raw units).

fields.name: quote_decimals
docs: Quote token decimals (prices and balances are in quote raw units).

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Padding for future expansion.

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: Market lifecycle status.

types.name: MatchReport
docs: End-of-call summary for a single aggressive order; emitted as an event.

fields.name: taker_order_id
docs: Sequence id assigned to this aggressive order.

fields.name: is_bid
docs: True if the aggressive order was a bid.

fields.name: total_base_filled
docs: Total base filled.

fields.name: total_quote_filled
docs: Total quote value filled (excludes fees).

fields.name: avg_fill_price
docs: VWAP of the fills.

fields.name: remaining_base
docs: Base quantity that remains unmatched (kept resting for limits).

fields.name: fills
docs: Per-fill breakdown.

fields.name: taker_fee_total
docs: Total taker fee charged this call.

fields.name: maker_fee_total
docs: Total maker fee charged this call.

fields.name: integrator_fee_total
docs: Total integrator fee charged this call (credited to `accumulated_integrator_fees`).

fields.name: self_trade
docs: True if a self-trade was detected and handled.

fields.name: order_expired
docs: True if any maker was skipped due to expiration.

types.name: OrderArgs
docs: Client input for a single order (used by place instructions and batches).

fields.name: is_bid
docs: True for a bid (buy), false for an ask (sell).

fields.name: price
docs: Limit price; `0` is treated as a market order.

fields.name: qty
docs: Quantity in base units.

fields.name: client_order_id
docs: Client-supplied order id.

fields.name: time_in_force
docs: Time-in-force for this order.

fields.name: self_matching_option
docs: Self-trade prevention mode.

fields.name: expire_timestamp
docs: Expiration timestamp in Unix seconds.

fields.name: market
docs: Market this book belongs to.

fields.name: authority
docs: Market authority (mirrors `MarketState.authority`).

fields.name: order_sequence
docs: Monotonic counter issuing `sequence` to resting orders (FIFO tiebreak).

fields.name: bid_head
docs: Highest-price active bid slot, or `NONE_IDX`.

fields.name: ask_head
docs: Lowest-price active ask slot, or `NONE_IDX`.

fields.name: bid_free
docs: Free-slot stack head for the bid pool, or `NONE_IDX`.

fields.name: ask_free
docs: Free-slot stack head for the ask pool, or `NONE_IDX`.

fields.name: bid_count
docs: High-water mark (slots ever handed out) for the bid pool.

fields.name: ask_count
docs: High-water mark (slots ever handed out) for the ask pool.

fields.name: bids
docs: Bid slot pool.

fields.name: asks
docs: Ask slot pool.

types.name: OrderCancelled
docs: Emitted when a resting order is cancelled.

types.name: OrderFilled
docs: Emitted after a match executes (taker or batch element).

types.name: OrderModified
docs: Emitted when an order is modified.

types.name: OrderNode
docs: On-disk representation of a resting order inside an `OrderBookState`.
Not an account: this borsh-serializes inside the order book account.

fields.name: active
docs: True while the slot is occupied by a live order.

fields.name: side
docs: Which side of the book this order rests on.

fields.name: price
docs: Limit price (quote units per base unit). Market-shaped leftovers never rest.

fields.name: qty_remaining
docs: Remaining unfilled quantity (base units).

fields.name: owner
docs: Owner of the order (trader).

fields.name: integrator
docs: Integrator credited with the integrator fee on this order.

fields.name: integrator_fee_bps
docs: Integrator fee rate (bp) locked at placement; capped per market.

fields.name: client_order_id
docs: Client-supplied order id used for cancels and reporting.

fields.name: sequence
docs: Book sequence number - FIFO tiebreaker at equal price.

fields.name: prev
docs: Previous slot in the per-side doubly linked list, or `NONE_IDX`.

fields.name: next
docs: Next slot in the per-side doubly linked list, or `NONE_IDX`.

fields.name: expire_timestamp
docs: Expiration timestamp in Unix seconds. Order is invalid after this time.

fields.name: filled_quantity
docs: Filled quantity so far, used for status and modification checks.

fields.name: time_in_force
docs: Time-in-force governing this order.

fields.name: self_matching_option
docs: Self-trade prevention mode.

types.name: OrderPlaced
docs: Emitted when a resting order is accepted onto the book.

types.name: OrderSide
docs: Side of the book.

fields.name: id
docs: Unique proposal id (monotonic per market).

fields.name: market
docs: Market this proposal targets.

fields.name: proposer
docs: Proposer (must meet minimum stake).

fields.name: taker_fee_bps
docs: Proposed taker fee (bps).

fields.name: maker_fee_bps
docs: Proposed maker fee (bps).

fields.name: votes_for
docs: Votes in favor (weighted by stake).

fields.name: votes_against
docs: Votes against (weighted by stake).

fields.name: start_epoch
docs: Epoch when voting started.

fields.name: end_epoch
docs: Epoch when voting ends.

fields.name: status
docs: Current proposal status.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `[b"proposal", market, id_bytes]`.

types.name: SelfMatchingOption
docs: Self-trade prevention mode.

types.name: SessionSettled
docs: Emitted at session settlement (pre-undelegation state summary).

fields.name: market
docs: Market this stake belongs to.

fields.name: owner
docs: Trader/owner of the stake.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount staked (quote units).

fields.name: epoch_activated
docs: Epoch when the stake became active.

fields.name: active
docs: Whether the stake is currently active (not yet unstaked).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `[b"stake", market, owner]`.

types.name: TimeInForce
docs: Time in force - only GTC for the MVP.

fields.name: owner
docs: Wallet that owns this trader account.

fields.name: base_balance
docs: Base asset balance (internal ledger).

fields.name: quote_balance
docs: Quote asset balance (internal ledger).

fields.name: status
docs: Status of the trader.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `[b"trader", market, owner]`.

fields.name: deposited_base
docs: Total base tokens deposited into the pool vault.

fields.name: deposited_quote
docs: Total quote tokens deposited into the pool vault.

fields.name: base_vault
docs: Trader's base SPL token account (ATA or explicit).

fields.name: quote_vault
docs: Trader's quote SPL token account (ATA or explicit).

fields.name: staked_amount
docs: Staked quote amount for fee discounts / governance.

fields.name: stake_epoch
docs: Epoch when stake becomes active.

fields.name: epoch_maker_fees_paid
docs: Maker fees paid in the current epoch (reset at epoch advance).

types.name: TraderStatus
docs: Trader status.

fields.name: market
docs: Market this vault belongs to.

fields.name: vault_base_balance
docs: Pool's base token balance (SPL Token account).

fields.name: vault_quote_balance
docs: Pool's quote token balance (SPL Token account).

fields.name: settled_base
docs: Base tokens the pool owes to traders (outgoing settlement liability).

fields.name: settled_quote
docs: Quote tokens the pool owes to traders (outgoing settlement liability).

fields.name: owed_base
docs: Base tokens traders owe to the pool (incoming settlement receivable).

fields.name: owed_quote
docs: Quote tokens traders owe to the pool (incoming settlement receivable).

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump for `[b"vault", market]`.

types.name: WithdrawEvent
docs: Emitted on withdrawal from the pool vault.
